title: A Mean Field Games Perspective on Evolutionary Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2603.27137v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a control-theoretic framework for evolutionary clustering based on quasi-stationary Mean Field Games. Each cluster is represented by a probability density whose evolution is governed by a Fokker--Planck equation, while the associated velocity field is determined through a stationary Hamilton--Jacobi equation. The general formulation does not prescribe a finite-dimensional statistical shape for the component densities, although the number of components is fixed. In the Gaussian specialization, we show that suitable affine dynamics reproduce the mean and covariance trajectories generated by the classical Expectation--Maximization procedure. To improve temporal coherence in the presence of noise and temporary cluster overlaps, we introduce causal and non-causal time-averaged log-likelihood objectives. translated_title: 演化聚类的平均场博弈视角
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于准稳态平均场博弈的演化聚类控制论框架。每个聚类由一个概率密度表示，其演化由Fokker-Planck方程控制，而相关的速度场则通过稳态Hamilton-Jacobi方程确定。尽管分量数量是固定的，但一般公式并不为分量密度规定有限维的统计形状。在高斯特化情形下，我们证明了合适的仿射动力学可以重现经典期望最大化（EM）算法生成的均值和协方差轨迹。为了在存在噪声和暂时聚类重叠的情况下提高时间一致性，我们引入了因果和非因果的时间平均对数似然目标函数。我们还为非高斯分量开发了一种完全基于密度的数值实现方法。
tldr: 提出了一种基于准稳态平均场博弈的演化聚类控制论框架，通过Fokker-Planck方程描述聚类密度的演化，在高斯情形下可重现经典EM算法的结果，并引入时间平均对数似然目标函数以提高存在噪声和聚类重叠时的时间一致性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a control-theoretic framework for evolutionary clustering based on quasi-stationary Mean Field Games, where cluster densities evolve via Fokker-Planck equations, reproducing EM algorithm trajectories in the Gaussian case and introducing time-averaged log-likelihood objectives to improve temporal coherence under noise and temporary cluster overlaps.
